== Notes ==
* Incendiary Arrows is the only bow attack that can hit several foes without removing the current [[preparation]], which can be useful to:
**Spread conditions more easily with [[Apply Poison]] or [[Barbed Arrows]]. 
**Trigger damage from [[Ignite Arrows]] on each of several foes hit.
**Interrupt more foes with [[Disrupting Accuracy]].
* The attack will also hit foes behind you, if these foes are in nearby range of the target.
